title: The maxmin-$\omega$ eigenvector extraction conjecture
statement: Let $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ have rational entries, let $p\in[n]$, and set $\omega=p/n$. Let $\lambda_p$ be the eigenvalue produced by the refinement algorithm, and let $\overline{D}_p$ be its resulting DBM representation. **Maxmin-$\omega$ eigenvector extraction conjecture.** Whenever the refinement algorithm yields the eigenvalue $\lambda_p$, it also yields an eigenvector obtainable from at least one column of $\overline{D}_p$. This conjecture is motivated by the reported successful experiments, in which such a column was always an eigenvector; the supplied text gives no proof or resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.16778

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2024).
source_name: Muhammad Syifa'ul Mufid, Ebrahim Patel and Sergei Sergeev, “On the maxmin-ω eigenspaces and their over-approximation by zones”, arXiv:2407.16778 (2024).
